v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Quo ábiit * diléctus tuus, o pulchérrima mulíerum? quo declinávit diléctus tuus, et quærémus eum tecum?
text.en: Whither is thy beloved gone, * O thou fairest among women? Whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.

text.la: Recédite a me, * amáre flebo, nolíte incúmbere, ut consolémini me.
text.en: Look away from me. * I will weep bitterly. Labour not to comfort me.

text.la: Non est ei * spécies neque decor, et vídimus eum, et non erat aspéctus.
text.en: He hath no form nor comeliness, * and when we shall see him there is no beauty that we should desire him.

text.la: A planta pedis * usque ad vérticem cápitis non est in eo sánitas.
text.en: From the sole of the foot * even unto the head, there is no soundness in it.

text.la: Fulcíte me flóribus, * stipáte me malis, quia amóre lángueo.
text.en: Revive me with flowers, * stay me up with apples for I am swooning with love.

text.la: Cui comparábo te? vel cui assimilábo te, fília Ierúsalem? cui exæquábo te, et consolábor te, virgo fília Sion? Magna est velut mare contrítio tua.
text.en: To what shall I compare thee? or to what shall I liken thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? to what shall I equal thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Sion? for great as the sea is thy destruction: who shall heal thee?

v.en: Pray for us, O Queen of Martyrs.

r.en: Who didst stand by the Cross of Jesus.

text.la: Oppréssit me dolor, * et fácies mea intúmuit a fletu, et pálpebræ meæ caligavérunt.
text.en: Sorrow hath crushed me; * My face is swollen with weeping, and on mine eyelids is the shadow of death.

text.la: Deus, in cuius passióne, secúndum Simeónis prophetíam, dulcíssimam ánimam gloriósæ Vírginis et Matris Maríæ dolóris gládius pertransívit: concéde propítius; ut, qui dolóres eius venerándo recólimus, passiónis tuæ efféctum felícem consequámur:
text.en: O God, at Whose suffering the prophecy of Simeon was fulfilled, and a sword of sorrow pierced through the gentle soul of the glorious Virgin and Mother Mary, mercifully grant that we who speak worshipfully of her woes, may obtain the saving purchase of thy suffering.
